text_block_list.text:
On a day off. Having some business to 
attend to, Hokko Tarumae and I arrived at 
a port town by ferry.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Ugh, w-well then... let's begin. A 
simulation... for creating the video.

As part of her locodol activities, we are 
producing a video introducing a travel 
itinerary for Tomakomai. Today's business 
is the dry run for that.

The actual filming will take place in 
Tomakomai, but today's goal is to ensure 
the course layout is reasonable. That is 
why we traveled to this town, but—
choice_data_list: Are you feeling okay... not seasick?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... This time it's the full-immersion 
course... Being a bit dizzy from the long 
journey makes it all the more 
realistic...!
choice_data_list:
You didn't have to go as far as taking a 
boat...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, but...! I really wanted people to see 
the port town of Tomakomai from the sea, 
too...!

...Knowing how seriously she obsesses over 
things, even a dry run won't be 
straightforward. For now, we took a break 
until she recovered—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Now then, having arrived in town... first 
up is getting some food, I'd imagine. And 
of course, you'll want to try the local 
specialties.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What kind of local specialty should we 
pick...? Trainer, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, I see. In that case, would 
this naturally be the time to recommend 
surf clam curry?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Then! Let's go find a place where we 
can eat seafood curry! Actually tasting it 
is what's important!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Like how many side dishes we can add! Or 
how heavy our stomachs will feel after 
eating! Let's test it out together!

—And naturally, it goes without saying... 
I really should prepare... separate 
recommended menus... for Umamusume and 
humans...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"—Alright, we've moved on to Lake Utonai. 
Remember, we are at Lake Utonai now. 
Please use this picture to visualize it."

...Standing before a sign that clearly 
showed the park's name, Hokko Tarumae 
proudly spoke while displaying a photo of 
Lake Utonai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If we include this in the plan, I suppose 
the trip would have to be during the 
migratory bird season—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm gonna go be a migratory 
bird for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Picture a swan in your mind while you 
watch me run, Trainer. Just relax and 
enjoy the show like a tourist!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Well then... ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Phew! Alright! How was that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Can you do a little better?
choice_data_list: Did you shave some time off?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Wait, no! Right now, that's 
not the comment I wanted to hear!
choice_data_list:
…I was moved by the beauty of the 
migratory birds

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see! In that case, it makes total 
sense that you'd want a souvenir related 
to migratory birds!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! If that's the case... 
at the end of the intro, I'll add a brief 
explanation about the nearby souvenir 
shop, and—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, I see a mountain of modest height 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If we take that to be Mount Tarumae... 
what would people think first when looking 
at it, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you think they'll 'want to climb 
it' after all? If so, we'll need to 
mention in the video that they should 
properly prepare for mountain climbing 
before going—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I have to take into account the 
difference in stamina between an Umamusume 
and a human. —Trainer-san, do you still 
have some time?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, let's do a little climbing! I 
did bring along the bare minimum 
equipment, just in case."

And following Hokko Tarumae's lead, I 
ended up hiking up the mountain, panting 
and gasping all the way—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for keeping me company 
today! Thanks to you, it was really 
helpful.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Being able to verify it from both an 
Umamusume's and a human's perspective was 
huge. ...Though we might want to narrow 
the concept down a bit more to suit the 
latter.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If we were to make one of these the main 
focus... which one did you think was best, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I was deeply moved by the strength of the 
migratory birds.
I guess the curry was good, huh?

Now I want to actually climb Mt. Tarumae 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's great! It was totally worth 
actually running and doing that migratory 
bird simulation!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well then... maybe in the video, I'll add 
a scene where I run like a migratory bird. 
Hehehe.

...Regardless, it seemed to have served as 
a meaningful rehearsal for Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. That delicious flavor and spice 
will revitalize them, putting a spring in 
their step for sightseeing."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's actually what turns into the surf 
clam curry, after all. It'll definitely 
make for a great memory!

...Regardless, it seemed to have served as 
a meaningful rehearsal for Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Did you think so? Fufu, it really was 
worth climbing the mountain, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if you ever think about climbing 
the real Mount Tarumae, please let me know 
beforehand. Choosing the right gear and 
route is essential for mountain climbing!”

...Regardless, it seemed to have served as 
a meaningful rehearsal for Hokko Tarumae.
